assessment: Finish the required labs in each module: they are checked automatically and explained when something is missing.
Pass each module quiz (70% or more). You can retry as often as you like.
Complete the final project and the final assessment to finish the course.

faq.a: To run the macros you write, yes: VBA runs inside the desktop version of Excel for Windows or Mac, not in a browser. Every lesson gives code you can paste into your own copy. The practice labs in GrowQR train the thinking around macros without needing Excel.

faq.q: Do I need to know programming?
faq.a: No. The course starts with the recorder and builds up. You should be comfortable with Excel formulas first; Basic Excel and Advanced Excel are good preparation.
Yes for automating Excel and other Office programs, and the ideas (variables, decisions, loops, errors) carry straight over to other languages.
Finishing every module and the final assessment marks the course complete on your GrowQR profile.
